title: Getting Started with PICO-8
description: A beginner's guide to the PICO-8 fantasy console: where it comes from, the command line, SPLORE, the code and sprite editors, and making a first animation with clouds drifting across the screen.

title: Understanding Wavetable Synthesis
description: Designing a sine wave oscillator from a single-cycle wavetable: the math of phase and table index, stepping through a table, linear interpolation in Python, and building a four-waveform wavetable in Max/MSP.
